description: This source file defines the GDPR controller class for the OpenCart catalog module. It handles GDPR-related actions such as displaying GDPR information, processing GDPR requests, and providing success or error responses. The class methods include index(), action(), and success(), managing GDPR data interactions, form handling, and view rendering within the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class managing GDPR-related functionalities within the OpenCart catalog module. It extends the core Controller class and provides methods for displaying GDPR information, processing GDPR requests, and showing success/error pages.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display GDPR information page if the information exists; otherwise, redirects to a not found page.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles GDPR-related form submission, validation, and processing requests based on provided email and actions such as export or remove. Returns a JSON response indicating success or error.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays the GDPR success page, optionally validating an access code, and updating GDPR status and results based on database records.
